contact.title: How can we help?
contact.description: Choose what you’re contacting us about so your message reaches the right person.
contact.success: We’ll reply to the email address you provided when a response is needed.
contact.emailHint: We’ll use this address to reply about your message. This doesn’t subscribe you to emails.
contact.inlineDescription: Report a problem, ask a question, or discuss working together. A few details help us get you to the right person.

report_issue.label: What went wrong, and what should have happened?
report_issue.hint: Describe the problem and any error you saw. Don’t include passwords or security codes.

general_inquiry.label: What would you like to know?
general_inquiry.hint: A little background helps us give you a useful answer.

account_support.label: What do you need help with?
account_support.hint: Describe the account problem. We’ll never ask for your password or sign-in code.

membership_support.label: What do you need help with?
membership_support.hint: Tell us about your API Access subscription, an older membership, or any problem with billing, access or features. Don’t include card details, passwords or security codes.

library_correction.label: Which library, and what needs correcting?
library_correction.hint: Include the library name or page link, the correct information, and a source if you have one.

plans.label: What would you like to discuss?
plans.hint: Tell us about your library or service, what you’d like to use, or your verification question.

partnership.label: What do you have in mind?
partnership.hint: Tell us about your organisation, your idea, and how we could work together.

privacy.label: What’s your question or request?
privacy.hint: Describe the request. Please don’t send identity documents or sensitive personal information here.
privacy.placeholder: I would like to ask about…

sponsorship.label: What would you like to sponsor?
sponsorship.hint: Tell us about your organisation, the programme you’re interested in and, if you know them, your budget and timing. Don’t include payment details.
sponsorship.placeholder: We’re… and would like to support…
